name: InterContinental Fiji Golf Resort & Spa
insider_take: This stunning resort sits on Natadola Beach, consistently ranked among the world's most beautiful beaches, where championship golf meets pristine white sand and crystal-clear lagoons.
whats_special: The resort features Fiji's only authentic links-style golf course designed by Vijay Singh, stretching along dramatic clifftops with ocean views from every hole. The property also houses the largest overwater spa in the South Pacific, built on stilts above a natural lagoon where tropical fish swim beneath treatment rooms.
pro_tip: Book your spa treatment during low tide for the best views of marine life through the glass floor panels, and time your golf round for late afternoon when the trade winds are calmest.
dont_miss: The resort's private island picnic experience on a secluded sandbar that appears only at low tide, and the traditional Fijian meke dance performances held weekly on the beach at sunset, featuring authentic fire dancing by local village performers.
pros: Championship 18-hole golf course with ocean views
Multiple swimming pools including infinity pool
Full-service spa with traditional Fijian treatments
cons: Limited nearby dining options outside resort
